# Audio

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

A terminal audio channel. Failed loads return an invalid object; inspect `Error.Last()` for details.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#audio).

## Channel

`Audio.Channel: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Logical PPL channel 0–13; it maps to SyncTERM/CTerm channel 2–15.

## Fade

```PPL
Audio.Fade(INTEGER targetVolume, INTEGER durationMs) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Fades this channel to `targetVolume` over `durationMs`. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends `APC SyncTERM:A;Volume;C=channel;V=dB;T=durationMs ST`; volume 0–100 is converted to decibels.

## Free

```PPL
Audio.Free() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Stops and releases this channel. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends `APC SyncTERM:A;Flush;C=channel;O=0 ST`; the client cache may remain for reuse.

## Load

```PPL
Audio.Load(STRING file) Audio
```

Static function.

Loads a board-relative WAV, AIFF, FLAC, Ogg/Vorbis or Opus file up to 16 MiB. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** probes using `APC SyncTERM:Q;libsndfileFormat;major;subtype ST`, expects `CSI = 7 ; 101 ; major ; subtype ; supported n`, and uploads with `APC SyncTERM:C;S;cacheName;base64 ST`. Requires SyncTERM/CTerm media and audio extensions.

## Play

```PPL
Audio.Play([BOOLEAN looping]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Starts playback; optional `looping` defaults to `FALSE`. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends `APC SyncTERM:A;Load;S=slot;cache ST`, `…;Volume;C=channel;V=dB ST`, then `…;Queue;C=channel;S=slot[;L] ST`. Non-looping playback also sends `…;Update;C=channel ST`. Requires SyncTERM/CTerm audio APC support.

## Playing

`Audio.Playing: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether this loaded channel is currently tracked as active.

## SetVolume

```PPL
Audio.SetVolume(INTEGER volume) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Sets the logical volume from 0 through 100 and returns whether it succeeded. On failure, `Error.Last()` provides `ErrKind.Audio`, an error code, message and channel.

## Stop

```PPL
Audio.Stop() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Stops this channel without freeing its data. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends `APC SyncTERM:A;Flush;C=channel;O=0 ST` (`APC` = `ESC _`, `ST` = `ESC \`).

## StopAll

```PPL
Audio.StopAll() BOOLEAN
```

Static function.

Stops every active PPL audio channel by sending `APC SyncTERM:A;Flush;C=channel;O=0 ST` for each one.

## Valid

`Audio.Valid: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether this value identifies a successfully loaded terminal audio channel.
